notes.text: The passage states that the conquest of Argyle by Alexander II and the subsequent annexation of the Western Islands to Scotland contributed to the destruction of the race of Conn's power as an independent tribe.
notes.evidence_quote:
The  conquest  of  Argyle  by  Alexander  II.,  and  the  subsequent  annexa- 
tion of  the  Western  Islands  to  the  kingdom  of  Scotland,  under  the  reign 
of  his  successor,  annihilated  the  power  of  the  race  of  Conn  as  an  indepen- 
dent tribe
